title: Macroscopic fundamental-diagram anchors (flow / density / wave speed)
scope: Aggregate flow-density-speed behaviour reconstructed with Edie's generalised definitions over space-time cells.

capacity_veh_per_h_per_lane.cite: classic freeway FD anchors (Cassidy & Bertini lineage)
capacity_veh_per_h_per_lane.source: Standard freeway lane-capacity anchor, ~1800-2400 veh/h/lane, as summarised in docs/realism/investigation/research-realism-benchmarks.json benchmarks[6] and findings section A.4; the queue-discharge / capacity lineage is Cassidy & Bertini, 'Some traffic features at freeway bottlenecks', Transportation Research Part B 33(1), 1999, doi:10.1016/S0191-2615(98)00014-0.
capacity_veh_per_h_per_lane.note: Scored against a robust maximum (p99) of per-cell Edie flow, so a single noisy cell cannot pass or fail the gate.

capacity_drop_fraction.source: Queue-discharge capacity drop of ~5-15% relative to pre-queue capacity: Cassidy & Bertini, Transportation Research Part B 33(1), 1999, and follow-ups; summarised in research-realism-benchmarks.json benchmarks[6].
capacity_drop_fraction.note: PINNED FOR LATER PHASES. Phase 0 does not identify bottleneck activation times, so the capacity drop is not computed; the number is pinned here so Phase 1/3 use the same audited value.

backward_wave_speed_kmh.source: Congested/backward wave speed ~15-20 km/h, summarised in docs/realism/investigation/research-realism-benchmarks.json benchmarks[6]; same Cassidy & Bertini 1999 lineage.
backward_wave_speed_kmh.note: Estimated as the negative slope of a least-squares line through the congested branch (cells denser than the flow-maximising density) of the reconstructed flow-density scatter.

min_congested_cells_for_wave_speed.source: Project-adopted minimum number of congested space-time cells before a backward-wave-speed regression is reported. Below it the metric degrades to 'na' rather than fitting a line to noise.
min_congested_cells_for_wave_speed.note: Sample-size floor, not a published measurement.
